set.body:
Ordinary gaps rather than defects, separated from the as.matrix correctness bug on bd-01KZY99TXMHQYMAYA4VQDZCWFD so that the bug can be fixed without waiting on these.

Registered today: 10 print, 10 format, 6 as.data.frame. Zero summary, zero plot, zero as.matrix, zero coef.

  NO summary() FOR ANY CLASS. summary() on an rsa result falls through to summary.default and
  prints a storage-mode listing of the underlying list. For an object whose entire purpose is
  a scientific summary that is worse than nothing.
  CONSTRAINT IF ADDED: a summary MUST state that values are signed and may be negative.
  Otherwise it invites reading a median as a positive quantity, which would silently undo the
  package most distinctive inferential commitment.

  NO as.data.frame FOR effect_geometry. Verified: coercion fails. This is the object the README
  tells you to build and keep, and the only one you cannot table. SAFE to add - the geometry is
  already materialized. MUST NOT be added for the plan class, which would hide materialization;
  make that one error naming geometry(plan) instead.

  THE ESCAPE HATCH IS A DEAD END. geometry_component returns a packed matrix in svec
  half-vectorized coordinates with sqrt(2) off-diagonal scaling (R/result.R:679-689), and the
  inverse unpacker at R/views.R:289 is NOT EXPORTED. A user wanting the plain condition-by-
  condition matrix at one voxel must re-derive the packing convention by hand or hand-build an
  indicator query. Export the unpacker.

  NO coef() ON THE RSA VIEW, whose payload element is literally named coefficients.

  NO plot(). For a package whose output is one value per voxel, there is no visualization
  affordance at all.

  THE RECEIPT IS INVISIBLE. A 16-field provenance record rides on every view and has no print
  method, so the provenance the package is proud of is unreachable without inspecting structure
  manually.

ONE ADDITION TO print.effect_geometry, and one thing NOT to change. Add a next-steps line: a user holding a geometry has no indication that contrast, rdm, rsa and geometry_spectrum are the four things to try, whereas the plan class already prints 'call geometry(plan) to materialize' and is the friendliest thing in the package. KEEP the existing line reading 'signed cross-generalized form; PSD not assumed'. I criticised that line earlier and withdrew it on bd-01KZY901ZPM73SBFAY79WR5PM7: it is the guarantee doing its job and telling the user not to truncate negatives.
set.title: Complete the object protocol: no summary, no plot, no coercion off effect_geometry, unexported svec unpacker
